messages:
Lena (Product): Heads-up 1: quick design check for the Private setup preflight screen. Main things: the live connectivity status isn't announced by screen readers, the telemetry consent copy feels vague, and the failure details are dense. Can we iterate?
Tom (Design): Got it. Can you paste the modal text? Also any screenshots?
Lena (Product): Current modal: `We'll run a network preflight and may send anonymized diagnostics to help debug issues.` No screenshots yet.
Ravi (Eng): Technical note: the payload only contains probe outcomes, IP ranges involved, and HTTP error codes + timestamps. We never include user tokens or payloads.
Asha (Accessibility): For the live status: add aria-live="polite" and a visually-hidden status summary that reads: "Preflight running  results will be read aloud when ready." Also when results arrive set focus to result summary and announce how many issues.
Tom (Design): Copy suggestion: `Run preflight 0: we may send anonymous network data (IP ranges, probe results, error codes) to help diagnose failures. No credentials or app data are collected.` Shorter second sentence: `You can disable this in your org settings.`
Iris (Legal): That seems fine, but avoid 'anonymous' as the only descriptor. Prefer 'anonymous network data' and make the opt-out visible. We need consent recorded in the audit log.
Lena (Product): Proposed modal layout: checkbox (checked by default) labelled "Share anonymous network data to help Redwood debug issues" with a small inline 'Learn more' link. Beneath that a secondary link: "Turn off reporting" which toggles the checkbox off.
Ravi (Eng): API accepts `telemetry=true|false`. We can log the consent: we'll emit an audit event `preflight.telemetry_consent` with org and user id.
Tom (Design): On the failure panel: instead of a big paragraph, show compact rows with icons: Column A: short title (e.g., 'Firewall blocked probe'), Column B: one-line why it matters, Column C: one-line suggested fix + 'More help' link. Keep lines <= 80 chars.
Asha (Accessibility): Make each row a focusable button with role="button" and aria-describedby linking to the expanded guidance. When keyboard focus enters the failure list, set focus to first failing row and announce `Preflight complete: 1 issue found`.
Lena (Product): CTA text currently 'Retry check'. Thoughts on 'Run again' vs 'Retry'?
Tom (Design): 'Run again' reads less like a form action, I'd pick that. Add tiny helper copy: 'Tip: run as admin if you see permission errors.'
Ravi (Eng): Also callout: probes have a 5s timeout by default; intermittent infra can cause false negatives. We should add a tooltip on the status icon: 'Probe timeout: 5s'.
Iris (Legal): One more thing: update privacy docs link in the 'Learn more' to the exact section about diagnostics. Legal will review final wording but this flow is acceptable.
Lena (Product): OK I'll update mocks with the checkbox, new copy, and the three-column failure rows. Will add the aria-live summary and focus handling notes for the eng ticket.
deploy-bot: preview created at https://staging.redwood.ai/previews/1780012345  build OK
Tom (Design): Nice. Small nit: avoid 'diagnose' and 'diagnostics' back-to-back. Maybe second sentence: 'This helps us find and fix common connection issues.'
Lena (Product): Great call. I'll post updated copy + PNGs in a follow-up message and tag legal for sign-off. Thanks all!
